headline: Black Rose Dragon
title: Black Rose Dragon Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Black Rose Dragon. What is it? It is a Level seven FIRE Dragon Synchro Monster with two thousand four hundred attack. What does it do? When it is Synchro Summoned you can destroy all cards on the field. It can also banish a Plant from your Graveyard to turn a defending monster to Attack Position with zero attack. How do you use it? Summon it when you are behind and clear everything, then rebuild. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
